newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha sidelined, but steady in mogas market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha sidelined, but steady in mogas market.

text.p: NWE naphtha was sidelined on Thursday as market attention remained riveted on gasoline.
Naphtha's fortunes mirrored those of gasoline and initial $1 gains on the back of gasoline's morning strength were quickly shed once heavy NYMEX gasoline selling became apparent.
Naphtha finished the day at much the same level it had started.
Supplies of naphtha remain hard to secure and set against this is fair demadn for full range and heavy naphtha.
"We have be seeing such a roller coaster ride I think people are sitting it out until it calms down a bit," said one trader.
August naphtha swaps were put at $191.50-192.00, very marginally firmer than Wednesday. September remained backwardated by $4 or so.
